name: Flag-Complex Persistent Homology
problem_statement: Compute persistence intervals over a declared prime field for the flag-complex filtration induced by nonnegative undirected edge filtration values.

normalization: Reject self-loops; duplicate edges collapse to their minimum filtration value.

problem_inputs.name: max_homology_dimension
problem_inputs.description: Nonnegative largest homology dimension to report.

problem_inputs.name: max_filtration
problem_inputs.description: Nonnegative finite cutoff; null means no cutoff.

problem_inputs.name: field_prime
problem_inputs.description: Prime coefficient modulus supported by the selected implementation.

required_outputs.name: intervals
required_outputs.description: Each interval specifies dimension, birth, and death; null death denotes survival beyond the cutoff.

required_outputs.name: essential_interval_convention
required_outputs.description: Explain whether null means essential in the complete filtration or right-censored at the cutoff.

solution_semantics.objective: Compute persistence intervals over a declared prime field for the flag-complex filtration induced by nonnegative undirected edge filtration values.
solution_semantics.exactness: Exact mathematical objective; implementations must declare approximation and termination status.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Each external vertex ID occurs once; output multiplicities follow the declared task.
solution_semantics.ordering: No ordering among equally valid solutions is required.

validation_rules: Vertices enter at zero; a clique simplex enters at the maximum filtration value of its edges.
Missing graph edges never enter; do not silently complete a sparse graph or reinterpret weights as similarities.
Compare barcode multisets against an independent small boundary-matrix reduction.
Intervals have birth <= death; specify whether zero-length intervals are omitted.
To compute dimension d, include simplices up to dimension d+1.
edge_cases: Disconnected components produce multiple surviving H0 intervals.
A 4-cycle has an H1 class until filling diagonals appear.
Equal filtration values require a face-compatible ordering.
